title: Great coach and a really...
text:
Great coach and a really good teacher.
He explained the rules very clearly and mixed them with practical exercises really well, which made it easy to learn and start playing quickly.

You could tell he prepared a lot beforehand and genuinely cared about the experience.
Very patient, attentive, and enjoyable to learn from.
author: Anonymous
